rules.fullName: QAC Payment Fulfillment Notification to website
rules.description: Send outbound messages to QCP queue whenver a Service Payment record relevant to agency related service request is created or updated
rules.formula: AND( Case__r.RecordType.Name = "Service Request", ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Origin, "QAC Website"), RecordType.Name = "Service Request", AND(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c, "Paid"), Initiated_fulfilment__c = False), ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Account.Type, "Agency Account"), NOT(ISBLANK(Case__r.Account.Qantas_Industry_Centre_ID__c)), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Group Waivers"),ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "SBT"),ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Service Request"), ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Type, "Commerical Waiver (non BART)"), CONTAINS( TEXT(Case__r.Problem_Type__c) , "Internal") ) ) )
